# matchedfilter COARSE THRESHOLD table -- measured, not modelled.
#
# THR n snr f ratio fd threshold
#
# The threshold the coarse maximum is compared against. Bisected
# directly against measured false dismissal until the rate meets fd,
# so the number stored IS the measurement: nothing derives it and
# nothing corrects it. It replaces hmf_threshold's Rice model plus a
# margin, which were two answers to one question.
#
# ratio = band / B_eff, the samples across the correlation peak. That
# is what scalloping depends on, it is dimensionless, and there is no
# n in it. Real references sit at 1.7 to 5.3; the old grid started at 8.
# 6000 trials a bisection step, 9 steps.
